flagsNote: Red flags are shown beside a stock, never used to rank it: excluding one-time profits or adjusting for demergers is a rule change that needs a backtest and a PREREGISTRATION entry first.

closeness.interpretation: real, usable edge (pro quant funds run IC ~0.03–0.06)

rankOdds.note: Historical frequencies from the 5-year backtest (causal; overlapping windows, so far fewer independent observations than samples). The blend weights were chosen on overlapping data, so treat these as slightly optimistic; the Friday ledger is the out-of-sample check.

raw.note: Long the top-decile by model score, rebalanced ~every 3 months, vs the equal-weight universe. Causal scores (no lookahead); current-constituent (survivorship-biased); simplified costs, no slippage.

sectorNeutral.note: Long the top-decile by model score, rebalanced ~every 3 months, vs the equal-weight universe. Causal scores (no lookahead); current-constituent (survivorship-biased); simplified costs, no slippage.

note: Value = TTM EPS (45d lag; annual 60d-lag fallback, unused once 550+ days past its year-end) over the current price — the same definition live and in the backtest (coverage.valueSource counts any stored-P/E fallbacks). Returns use closes adjusted for demerger-sized one-day gaps (coverage.corporateActionGaps). Costs charged on TURNOVER, not flat (0.4% round-trip on churn). Blend = cross-sectional robust-z of β-neutralized earnings yield (value, 60%) + 12-month momentum (40%) — the winner of an 8-hypothesis grid (quant/out/blend_lab.json: IC 0.085 vs 0.063 for the old 4-factor mix; mild selection bias from picking the best of 8, disclosed). Quality/growth still computed & reported (skill.factorIC) but measurably diluted the blend, so they carry zero weight. Accruals (Sloan (NI-OCF)/Assets from screener.in BS+CF annuals, sign-flipped so conservative scores high) is also computed + reported at zero weight until validated — see coverage.accrualsPct. Live weights are REGIME-ADAPTIVE (mom12m cut hard in Risk-off — it crashes in volatile bears); regime.adaptiveVsFixed shows the honest comparison. Backtest longs the top decile ~quarterly vs equal-weight universe. Causal; survivorship-biased; annual fundamentals + 60-day lag; simplified costs. IC = rank corr of score vs 63-day forward return. Not a forecast.
